description: Wait stats ops view: class composition, signal vs resource pressure, top wait types with avg/max, and fleet hotspot tables. Benign waits filtered in collector. Source: mssql_waits (120s). Rates are ms/s from cumulative DMVs.

panels.description: Servers where signal wait ratio is high - usually CPU / scheduler pressure.
panels.title: High Signal (>=25%)

panels.description: Servers where most cumulative wait time is actionable (non-benign).
panels.title: High Nonbenign (>=70%)

panels.description: Top 5 wait types own almost all non-benign time - focus triage there.
panels.title: Concentrated Top5 (>=90%)

panels.description: Highest signal-wait share among selected servers.
panels.title: Max Signal Ratio

panels.description: Highest share of wait time that is non-benign.
panels.title: Highest share of wait time that is non-benign.

panels.description: How concentrated non-benign waits are in the top 5 types.
panels.title: Max Top5 Share

panels.description: Wait type / server pairs with rate above 5s of wait time per second.

targets.expr: count(sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])) > 5000) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hot Wait Types

panels.description: Highest total wait-time accumulation rate (ms/s) on one server.

targets.expr: max(sum by (instance) (rate(mssql_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Max Wait Rate

panels.description: Stacked class rates. Dominant class points next dashboard: io->File I/O, lock->Locks/Blocking, parallelism->Parallelism, scheduler->CPU/Scheduler, memory->Memory, log->Log Usage.
panels.title: Wait Time by Class (ms/s)

panels.description: Current class leaders across selected servers.

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (instance, wait_class) (rate(mssql_waits_by_class_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_class=~"${wait_class:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.title: Top Classes Now

panels.description: How many waiting tasks accumulate per class - complements time-based view.
panels.title: Waiting Tasks by Class (ops/s)

panels.description: Overall wait pressure per instance (sum of filtered wait types).
panels.title: Total Wait Rate by Server

panels.description: Signal / total non-benign wait. Rising toward 20%+ often means runnable queue / CPU pressure.
panels.title: Signal Wait Ratio %

panels.description: Share of all wait time that is not filtered as benign idle waits.
panels.title: Nonbenign Wait %

panels.description: Concentration: if one or two waits dominate, fix those first.
panels.title: Top5 Share of Nonbenign %

panels.description: Resource waits = waiting on locks/IO/latches/etc. Signal waits = ready but waiting for CPU. High signal share -> check CPU / scheduler.
panels.title: Signal vs Resource Wait Rate (ms/s)

panels.description: Fastest-growing wait types right now (filtered by Server / Wait Type variables).

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.title: Top Wait Rates (ms/s)

panels.description: Largest single wait observed since stats reset (cumulative max).
panels.title: Top Max Wait Time

panels.description: Average ms per waiting task (cumulative). High avg = expensive waits even if rare.
panels.title: Top Avg Wait / Task

panels.description: Sort by Wait ms/s. High Signal share -> CPU. PAGEIOLATCH* -> storage. LCK_* -> blocking. CX* -> parallelism. WRITELOG -> log flush. ASYNC_NETWORK_IO -> client/app slow consume.

targets.expr: max by (instance, wait_type) (sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))
max by (instance, wait_type) (sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_signal_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))
max by (instance, wait_type) (sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_resource_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))
max by (instance, wait_type) (sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_waiting_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))

max by (instance, wait_type) ((mssql_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"} / clamp_min(mssql_wait_waiting_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}, 1)))

panels.title: Wait Type Detail (rate + signal/resource + avg)

panels.description: Top 10 series over time - watch for new wait types appearing after deployments or jobs.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.title: Top Wait Types Trend (ms/s)

panels.description: How frequently tasks hit each wait - complements time spent.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_waiting_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.title: Waiting Tasks Rate by Type

panels.description: Fleet triage table. Start with high Signal % or high Total Wait ms/s, then open the dominant class dashboard.

targets.expr: topk by (instance) (1, sum by (instance, wait_class) (rate(mssql_waits_by_class_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_class=~"${wait_class:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.title: Wait Health by Server

panels.description: CPU-pressure candidates - correlate with Scheduler / CPU dashboards.
panels.title: Hotspots: Signal Ratio >= 15%

max by (instance, wait_type) (sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_wait_signal_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))
